text.p: NOTES: Full company name is Millenium Chemicals Inc. Company began trading as a public company October 2, 1996 after being spun off from Hanson PLC. Pro forma earnings per share assume company was stand-alone entity for all periods presented and spin-off had been consummated on January 1, 1995.
Fourth quarter net income from continuing operations on a pro forma basis for 1996 comparable quarter in 1995.

Earnings per share for quarter and year ended December 31, 1996 would be $0.34 and $1.52, respectively, assuming post-demerger debt levels, normal corporate expenses and excluding one-time, unusual items.
Net income for 1966 on pro forma basis.

Full-year 1996 results, both actual and pro-forma, include pretax charges of $75 million ($48 million after tax, or $0.63 a share) relating to sulfate-process TiO2 production facility closures and a $210 million gain ($68million after tax, or $1.12 a share) realized on sale of majority interest in Suburban Propane.
